name: noodle-geofence
title: Nearby albums
description: New images within 250 metres of manually added images in albums starting with !.
author: Noodle Gallery

methods.name: sortUpload
methods.title: Add to nearby ! albums
methods.description: Uses album-specific Standortquelle tags for 250 m sources; no backfill.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Stored in workflow config; do not share workflow exports.

ownerId.title: Account ID
ownerId.description: Only process this account and its owned albums.

enabledAfter.title: Enable after
enabledAfter.description: ISO UTC timestamp; never move backwards. Older uploads are excluded.
